text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492.** Source: *Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth* (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers checking in at Dock Doors 14–18 at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that the 04:00 shift got through the gate without manual help. The note also has a follow-up to archive the kiosk logs before the 14 Oct maintenance window.
2. **#4419.** Source: *Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)* (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea also logged this one. The gatehouse barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags on the third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 product support for scanner firmware testing. The cheat sheet has no date, so I can't tell you when it was opened.

Some things I left out:
- Moss's other Quarrendon notes (the 9/14 pipeline digest and the 3/23/2026 renewal check-in) don't mention any ticket numbers.
- The ticket numbers in Moss's Central handoff digest (#4409, #4412, FR-882) are for Central accounts, not Quarrendon.
- Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" is about a different company. They aren't a Pemberline customer, so don't mix them up with Quarrendon.

I only looked through Moss's shared files. I didn't search channels for other ticket mentions.
